description: Open-source CLI that deploys vLLM and llama.cpp model servers to your own machine or to GPU cloud providers (Modal, RunPod) from HCL files, with plan, apply and destroy.
rules: Run `amicu validate` and `amicu plan` before `amicu apply`, and review the plan.
Start a new project with `amicu init` or `amicu init --example <name>`.
Never put API keys in HCL files; reference them with `secret(...)` in a `credential` block.
Use `amicu destroy` to stop deployments so state stays in sync.
Run `amicu doctor` when local setup or provider credentials fail.
